title: I was PLEASANTLY SURPRISED!!!
text:
I was PLEASANTLY SURPRISED!!!. Okay, so I don’t write a ton of reviews, and I sure haven’t written a review for spoons. But I knew I needed to write a review as soon as I saw the spoons {and matching forks} I had ordered! Allow me to explain. So, I’m sure I’m not the only person who has ordered something, and when it arrives it is much smaller, or is much more cheaply made than anticipated. Well, I can honestly say that is NOT the case with these spoons, nor is it with the matching forks. These spoons look and feel exactly as they are described by the seller. I was impressed and admittedly relieved that they truly were what I was hoping they would be! So, feel free to buy silverware from this seller! You won’t regret it!
OH! THERE IS ONE MORE THING THAT I FORGOT TO MENTION—I have had these spoons and forks for a little over two weeks. They have been washed in my dishwasher several times. And, they always come out perfectly fine!!

{Okay, I am done with my sincere, yet a tad bit over the top, review. And, just so you know, I wasn’t paid to do this review. Everything I wrote was true.} 😊
